dedupe_keys.name: d4 9 dataset01 building energy simulation data for case study buildings with hybridgeotabs and baseline hvac concepts

description: Ghent University and University of Leuven researchers publish annual hourly building-energy simulation results for three case-study sites. Coverage includes the Infrax office and Ter Potterie elderly home in Belgium, and the Haus M apartment building in Switzerland. The Excel download compares hybridGEOTABS control concepts with baseline HVAC configurations; model-predictive control is not included for Haus M. Published in April 2021, the data are free under CC BY 4.0. These simulated outputs can support control-strategy comparisons or checks against another building-energy simulation. Exact calendar year, column units and model-error estimates remain unknown from the repository summary. Related deliverable D4.9 provides the study context but was not downloaded. No related catalogue record explicitly covers these three output series. The workbook was not opened, and it should not be treated as measured building performance.
